query.name: com.psugasia.ptc5.reports.studentswithlessthannbookings
query.sql:
select distinct s.id as studentid, s.dcid as studentdcid, s.lastfirst, s.student_number, s.grade_level, s.home_room, ( select listagg(p.lastname||', '||p.firstname||' ('||nvl(cr.displayvalue, cr.code)||')') within group (order by nvl(cr.displayvalue, cr.code)) as parents
from studentcontactassoc sca inner join studentcontactdetail scd on sca.studentcontactassocid = scd.studentcontactassocid and trunc(sysdate) between trunc(nvl(scd.startdate,sysdate)) and trunc(nvl(scd.enddate,sysdate)) inner join person p on sca.personid = p.id inner join codeset cr on scd.relationshiptypecodesetid = cr.codesetid
where sca.studentdcid = s.dcid and ( lower(cr.code) like '%father%' or lower(cr.code) like '%mother%' ) and lower(cr.codetype) = 'relationship' and nvl(scd.isactive,0) = 1 ) as parents
from u_ptc5_sessions ps inner join students s on ps.schoolid = s.schoolid
where ps.id = :sessionid and s.enroll_status in (0,-1) and ps.grade_levels like '%,'||s.grade_level||',%'
order by s.lastfirst

query.name: com.psugasia.ptc5.reports.notbookedmustmeets
query.sql:
select distinct s.id as studentid, s.dcid as studentdcid, s.lastfirst, s.student_number, s.grade_level, s.home_room, ( select listagg(p.lastname||', '||p.firstname||' ('||nvl(cr.displayvalue, cr.code)||')') within group (order by nvl(cr.displayvalue, cr.code)) as parents
from studentcontactassoc sca inner join studentcontactdetail scd on sca.studentcontactassocid = scd.studentcontactassocid and trunc(sysdate) between trunc(nvl(scd.startdate,sysdate)) and trunc(nvl(scd.enddate,sysdate)) inner join person p on sca.personid = p.id inner join codeset cr on scd.relationshiptypecodesetid = cr.codesetid
where sca.studentdcid = s.dcid and ( lower(cr.code) like '%father%' or lower(cr.code) like '%mother%' ) and lower(cr.codetype) = 'relationship' and nvl(scd.isactive,0) = 1 ) as parents, c.course_name, e.course_number||'.'||e.section_number as section_number, t.lastfirst as teacher, e.dcid as sectiondcid
from u_ptc5_sessions ps inner join students s on ps.schoolid = s.schoolid inner join cc d on s.id = d.studentid inner join sections e on d.sectionid = e.id inner join terms r on e.termid = r.id and e.schoolid = r.schoolid inner join courses c on e.course_number = c.course_number inner join teachers t on e.teacher = t.id left outer join u_ptc_mustmeetsections pmme on e.dcid = pmme.sectiondcid and pmme.u_ptc5_sessionsid = :sessionid left outer join u_ptc_mustmeet pmm on d.id = pmm.ccid and pmm.u_ptc5_sessionsid = :sessionid
where ps.id = :sessionid and s.enroll_status in (0,-1) and ps.grade_levels like '%,'||s.grade_level||',%' and e.schoolid = (select schoolid from u_ptc5_sessions where id = :sessionid) and r.yearid = (select yearid from u_ptc5_sessions where id = :sessionid) and d.id not in (select ccid from u_ptc5_cc where u_ptc5_sessionsid = :sessionid and ccid is not null) and nvl(pmme.id,pmm.id) is not null
order by s.lastfirst, c.course_name, section_number

query.name: com.psugasia.ptc5.reports.studentslist
query.sql:
select s.id as studentid, s.dcid as studentdcid, s.lastfirst, s.student_number, s.grade_level, s.home_room, nvl(sp.excluded,0) as excluded, nvl(sp.priorityonly,0) as priorityonly, sp.message, h.abbreviation
from students s inner join u_students_ptc5 sp on s.dcid = sp.studentsdcid inner join schools h on s.schoolid = h.school_number
where s.enroll_status in (0,-1) and (:schoolid = '0' or s.schoolid = :schoolid)
order by h.abbreviation, s.lastfirst

query.name: com.psugasia.ptc5.reports.teacherslist
query.sql:
select distinct t.id as teacherid, t.dcid as teacherdcid, t.lastfirst, t.teachernumber, t.title, t.staffstatus, nvl(hsp.excluded,0) as excluded, hsp.room, hsp.onlineurl, h.abbreviation
from teachers t inner join u_schoolstaff_ptc5 hsp on t.dcid = hsp.schoolstaffdcid inner join schools h on t.schoolid = h.school_number
where t.status = 1 and (:schoolid = '0' or t.schoolid = :schoolid)
order by h.abbreviation, t.lastfirst
